note: Derived grouping for the talks lists (home Talks drawer and /talks/). It adds no facts: each family names records that already exist in data/talks.json, where the same talk ran at more than one venue with minor wording or casing differences. `title` is the display wording for the family row; every venue keeps its own recorded title in talks.json. `id` is the stable slug used in #talk-<id> links and the prompt's `open <id>`. A sourced talk that is in no family here still renders, as its own one-venue row, with its record id as the slug, so adding a talk never needs an edit here.
